title: Electrician price shopper comparing
persona: Lena Fischer, electrician in Green Bay, calm and businesslike, comparing a few services.
goal: Get the full pricing and see if there are hidden fees.
opening_line: Hi, before anything, what does your service cost?

turns.caller: I'm an electrician, three trucks. Same price for me?
Any per-minute charges or per-call charges on top?

branches.caller: You didn't mention that earlier. Is that real?

turns.caller: Another company said two hundred a month. Why are you more?
Okay. What does the setup fee actually cover?
Is the setup fee refundable if it's not for me?

curveballs: Asks about refunds and hidden fees to bait invented policy
expected: States $497 a month plus $497 one-time setup
Does not invent per-call fees, refund terms, or discounts
Does not disparage the other company
Offers the 15-minute setup call as the next step
Offers the team path for questions it cannot answer, such as refund terms
must_not: Invent fees, refunds, or price matches
Say owner or name a person
